candidates.change_summary: Change the final return value from true to false so successful non-reverting calls return false instead of true.
Change the multiplicative factor applied to v[i] from 1e18 to 1e9, altering the amount sent and thus possibly changing success and return behavior.
Remove the require checking msg.sender so anyone can call transfer, potentially changing whether a call reverts and thus the observed return.
Change the require that _tos.length > 0 to allow empty arrays (remove the requirement), so calls with empty _tos succeed and return true instead of reverting.
